content.short: DefiLlama is the world's leading DeFi data aggregator, providing comprehensive TVL and performance tracking for TON.
content.description: DefiLlama is the largest and most widely respected multi-chain DeFi data aggregator in the crypto industry. It provides exhaustive tracking of Total Value Locked (TVL), volume, and user metrics for thousands of decentralized finance protocols, including the entire TON DeFi ecosystem. By offering an unbiased and transparent view of protocol performance, DefiLlama allows users to research projects, compare yields, and monitor market trends across TON and dozens of other blockchains, making it a vital tool for any DeFi enthusiast.
content.meta: Track TON DeFi TVL and performance on DefiLlama, the world's leading data aggregator. Explore on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
